scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:bot && npm run deploy:web
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c apps/bot/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c apps/bot/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:list: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote -c apps/bot/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.backup: wrangler d1 export DB --remote --output osiris-backup.sql -c apps/bot/wrangler.jsonc
